pages.text: Like forging the wild armor trim, upgrading a $(item)leather$()$(br) is a service provided by $(#AA00AA)Wild Spirits$() and not bound any spirit to the final object.$(br) You sacrifice the items and the $(#AA00AA)Wild Spirits$() uses his power to forge that item for you.$(br) Use the $()
respective materials to obtain $(item)铜马铠$(),$(br) $(item)iron horse armor$(), $(item)golden horse armor$()$(br) or $(item)diamond horse armor$().$(br)
